## Overview

As the technology industry shifts from basic automation toward advanced generative-AI and autonomous systems, there is increased demand for graduates with the technical skills to design, build, and scale intelligent systems. This programme prepares you for rapidly evolving AI-focused roles across the computing sector by combining strong theoretical foundations with practical engineering.
